name: Youth Volunteer Shifts (Blue Ridge Area Food Bank, Charlottesville)
what_you_do: Sign up for a volunteer shift at the Charlottesville warehouse. You can also pick an offsite food distribution site. Kids and teens volunteer with a parent or guardian.
who_can_apply: Children ages 12 to 17 may volunteer if a parent or guardian is with them for each shift. In the Food Recovery Area, ages 12 to 16 need a parent or guardian at each shift. Volunteers ages 17 and older may work there without an adult after an initial shift with an adult. Youth groups ages 12 to 15 need one adult chaperone for every 3 children. Youth groups ages 16 and 17 need one adult for every 6 youth. Volunteers must be 18 or older at the Winchester warehouse.
duration: One shift at a time. Shift length is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for shifts on the online volunteer calendar. Group visits must be booked at least one month ahead.
how_to_apply: Create your own account on the online volunteer calendar. It is required for safety and communication. Then register for a shift. If you do not get a confirmation email, the registration did not go through. Contact the volunteer team at volunteer@brafb.org. Group sizes are 4 to 8 people at most locations. They are up to 10 at the Verona warehouse. Everyone needs their own account.
